result_text: Both tooltips now escape repository names, so a name like `acme "shop"` shows as typed and no markup reaches the page. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks** (`addLangInfo`): each repository name is passed through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is appended. - **Size distribution table** (the `info` string built near line 1332): the repository name is escaped the same way before the lines of code are appended. - Added the `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils` import, which the module already uses elsewhere. Counts, LOC values, ordering and layout are untouched. The module compiles offline (`mvn -o -pl reports test` reports BUILD SUCCESS). No existing test covers the landscape report generator, so the fix is verified by compilation and by reading the code, not by a rendered-page check. Nothing is committed.
